action.description: Which Slack write operation to perform. Pass only its matching params object.

conversationId.description: The EXISTING Cedar deal to attach the Slack thread to.

channelId.description: Slack channel id (e.g. "C0123ABC") — from a search-live match.

threadTs.description: Thread root ts to pull (e.g. "1700000000.123456"). Omit to pull the channel's recent messages.

syncThread.description: Pull a specific Slack thread from the connected user's LIVE Slack into an existing deal, where it's stored and attached to the conversation timeline. Get channelId/threadTs from slack-read's search-live first. This INGESTS + ATTACHES only — it does not search.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
